results.question: Which suppliers have products with an average rating above 4.5? Show supplier names and average ratings.
results.initial_sql:
WITH avg_ratings AS (
    SELECT
        p.supplier_id,
        AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating
    FROM
        products p
    JOIN
        reviews r ON r.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY
        p.supplier_id
    HAVING
        AVG(r.rating) > 4.5
)
SELECT
    s.name AS supplier_name,
    ar.average_rating
FROM
    suppliers s
JOIN
    avg_ratings ar ON ar.supplier_id = s.supplier_id;
results.final_sql:
WITH avg_ratings AS (
    SELECT
        p.supplier_id,
        AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating
    FROM
        products p
    JOIN
        reviews r ON r.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY
        p.supplier_id
    HAVING
        AVG(r.rating) > 4.5
)
SELECT
    s.name AS supplier_name,
    ar.average_rating
FROM
    suppliers s
JOIN
    avg_ratings ar ON ar.supplier_id = s.supplier_id;

results.question: For each product category, show the total quantity sold in delivered orders.
results.initial_sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id
    FROM orders
    WHERE status = 'delivered'
)
SELECT 
    c.name AS category_name,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity_sold
FROM 
    products p
JOIN 
    categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN 
    delivered_orders do ON oi.order_id = do.order_id
GROUP BY 
    c.name;

results.question: Which suppliers have at least five products currently in stock? Show supplier IDs, names, and the number of in-stock products.

)

results.question: For each order status, show the average number of items per order, counting item quantities rather than order-item rows.
results.initial_sql:
WITH order_status_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        status,
        COUNT(order_id) AS order_count
    FROM 
        orders
    GROUP BY 
        status
)
SELECT 
    os.status,
    os.order_count,
    1.0 * SUM(oi.quantity) / COUNT(oi.order_id) AS average_items_per_order
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN 
    order_status_counts os ON o.status = os.status
GROUP BY 
    os.status
ORDER BY 
    os.order_count DESC, 
    os.status ASC;
